foundations.rationale: Both Loop transitions return to a reproducible starting frame. Audio playback is explicitly started, and the Waveform technical explanation is available in About.

copy.rationale: Waveform keeps a compact editing surface and an About explanation. The study hints describe what Cycle controls and the phase restored by Loop. The speaker retains its accessible name.

interface.rationale: Use a 28 CSS-pixel icon target in the About row with current theme and focus styling. Clear dynamic Waveform text and audio notifications. Toggle tracks retain their on/off colors and position, and keyboard focus uses a black mark within the white thumb.

bar-and-exports.rationale: Reset clocks to the authored phases on both Loop transitions. Waveform reuses captured PCM and its fixed viewport at phase zero. GIF uses the existing captured sweep direction and SVG and PNG use the displayed frame.

media.rationale: Artemis II remains limited to existing Mission Control playback through its native MP3 element. Web Audio startup and optional live capture affect the existing generated audio only.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: No runtime assets or new institutional logo compositions are added. Two review screenshots document existing generator surfaces using the existing official vectors and brand fonts.

governance.rationale: The change applies the existing review policy and records its results. Policy, captured sources and the brand guard retain their current rules.

existingConflicts.disposition: Existing boundaries remain documented in brand_conflicts.md. Moving the existing audio action preserves playback eligibility and adds no use of disputed art or media.

approvalRationale: Existing controls and native audio synthesis are adjusted within the current generator. No new institutional composition, library submission, asset use or redistribution is proposed.
publicationScope: Owner authorized publication and merge in tennitech/the-bar-generator, including generator code, project notes, tests, and screenshots of the existing generator UI.
